items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: I had Bill Newton on the bass.

ctx.x: When was your last band about then? After the Banner band, did you give up playing dances

and just start teaching or writing? After the Banner, after the Banner we, at least, I was with the Black Eagle before I joined the band. That's the way it happened. We decided to break the Black Eagle up to reinforce the Banner band, which we did. And I took Ike Tomlin and went to New Iberic. And then the high stage they ever saw. And I came here and organized a little five-piece band right here. I had Frank Brown and Joe and Drum and Bo Frey and Clifton who was playing the banjo. He was in the French Quarter. I…
Are there any good old style bands here around in this part of the country anymore? No. The trombonist Gus, I can't remember his last name. Point net.
